title: No glucose register when use calc
symptom: When using Calc, no glucose is registered, but when using glucose it's OK. The issue occurred with Dev build 8fb17 on a Zenfone 8 running Android 12.
fix: The issue was resolved in a later Dev build (a20f4f..). The user states that with that build the issue does not happen.
evidence_quote: I think issue can be closed. With a20f4f.. Dev built this issue not happen
